messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **federal holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, keep in mind that each province may add its own holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario, BC, etc.—but the dates below are the nationwide ones that will give you a three‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Mon) |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Sat–Mon) |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) |

### How to use this list
- **Plan your getaway** around any of the long‑weekend spans above.  
- If you’re in a province that observes **Family Day** on a different date (e.g., British Columbia’s Family Day is on the 3rd Monday of February), adjust accordingly.  
- For holidays that fall on a weekend (New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day), the *observed* day is usually the following Monday, giving you a three‑day stretch.

Feel free to plug these dates straight into your holiday‑planning app! If you need the provincial variations or want to see the full calendar of all Canadian holidays for 2023, just let me know.
